results.content: Washington, D.C., September 1, 2026 – A new Ipsos poll finds that, as the U.S.’ current trade dispute with Canada escalates, a majority of Americans believe the U.S. should be willing to make tradeoffs with Canada, even if it means it doesn’t get most of what it wants (68%), rather than take a tough stance and insist on getting most of what it wants (25%). By nearly three to one, more oppose than support the U.S. placing additional tariffs on Canada (57% oppose, 20% support, 21% don’t know). [...] This survey also explores views towards the Iran War. Our FRED graph above tracks, side by side, the share of adults who say they’re “doing okay financially” from the SHED and the index values of consumer sentiment from the University of Michigan.
